s: @HU-558711706 @Kelly Ketel Valinge Misty White Oak is being installed this week. Contractor is doing floating method and he says it's easy, no problem. They are long planks for my smaller house so he is cutting them smaller. I will post more about what I think in a few months. We are using cork underlayment. Green Home Solutions Seattle also sells heat registers to match and they are around $80 each. I have not decided on heat registers yet. Also, I did not buy the Ultra version so there are knots in the wood planks which is fine with me as I plan on having large rugs.
